instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. In an outdoor covered concrete pavilion during the day, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) stands on the left with his back partially to the camera, extending his gloved right arm to punch. On the right, the man in the green long-sleeved shirt (R3) stands facing him in red shorts and grey clogs, holding up a black focus mitt to catch the punch. The two are engaged in active boxing mitt work, with R1's glove making contact with R3's mitt. The background shows a blue wooden board and metal pillars under natural daylight.
